articles.summary: Franklin's inspiring journey as an 8-year-old yorkie rescue dog battling hemangiosarcoma cancer with the help of FidoCure's AI-driven precision medicine. Learn how targeted therapies, originally developed for humans, are helping dogs like Franklin thrive and contribute to groundbreaking cancer research.
articles.title: Franklin’s Story: A Rescue Dog Thrives Thanks to Breakthrough Cancer Treatments

articles.summary: Romulus, a Maremma guardian dog, was given just 6-9 months to live after a bone cancer diagnosis. Thanks to FidoCure’s AI-driven precision medicine, he thrived for an additional four years. Learn how personalized veterinary care helped Romulus live his best life despite a tough diagnosis.
articles.title: Romulus’ Story: A Guardian Dog’s Cancer Tale
